chapter: Alma Hightower and other women musicians
title: Florence Cadrez, pianist
summary: Howard says Florence Cadrez was a fine pianist who worked jobs but not with him.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: Do you remember any other women players? Other than maybe--did Florence Cadrez (phonetic) ever play jobs? I know she was a pianist, wasn't she?
Oh, she was a pianist, yeah.
Did she ever work jobs? Club jobs --anything like that--that you know of?
Well, maybe not with you, but do you know--'cause you've known her a long time?
Has she worked any jobs, like with a band, or whatever?
She did? See, I didn't know. I knew she was an excellent pianist at one period.
You'd love to hear her play.
Can you put it a little closer please?
You'd love to hear her play.
Yeah, I knew that. But see, I didn't know, 'cause when I had a chance to meet her, she was --what--recording secretary? You were financer, weren't you?
--767, and so I don't think she was playing much through that period, except for her own benefit.
